{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Compute change in biomarker
trial_df['biomarker_change'] = trial_df['biomarker_final'] - trial_df['biomarker_baseline']

# Check for sentinel values in change
print('Number of patients with -999.0 in baseline or final:')
print((trial_df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999.0).sum() + (trial_df['biomarker_final'] == -999.0).sum() - (trial_df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999.0 & trial_df['biomarker_final'] == -999.0).sum())
print('\n')

# Now compute mean change by arm
mean_change_by_arm = trial_df.groupby('arm')['biomarker_change'].mean()
print('Mean biomarker change by arm:')
print(mean_change_by_arm)"}
